name: Littlebird
description: Littlebird lets agents search the signed-in user's Littlebird memory of meetings, decisions, and past work. It needs a Littlebird Power plan or higher, and each user signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: What did we decide about the pricing change last week?
Summarize what I worked on yesterday.
Find what I discussed with Anna about the launch plan.

apps.name: Littlebird
apps.description: Search of meetings, decisions, and past work, over Littlebird's MCP server with browser sign-in.
